reason: Opcodes, addressing modes, branch ranges and the reordering are fine (Y stays MOVER_SLOTS, y1/y2 independent, no SMC here). The per-execution count is overstated: the y1-kept path saves 1 (BCS taken 3 -> BCC not taken 2), but the y1-store path now costs 1 more (BCC taken 3 to the out-of-line STA, +RTS vs BCS not taken 2 falling in), so at the claimed 90% kept it is 0.8 a call, not 1.0. The code also grows by 1 byte (23 -> 24; the claim's bytes -1 means it costs one), and I built both versions (scratchpad copy, same defines) and diffed the listings: everything in bank 4 from list_overlap (&9948 -> &9949) to the end of the bank moves up 1, and that changes page crossings the claim says do not change. One gets better: BEQ gathered at &9EFD (the gather loop's exit, once a call) stops crossing, -1. Several get worse: straight_sprite_hi moves &A4E4 -> &A4E5, so LDA straight_sprite_hi,X in ren_draw_sprite (&9B34) and in the sky image builder (&C231) now crosses a page for X=&1B (straight_1b, a real sprite in ANDY), +1 each time that sprite is drawn. wa_rows_guess moves &A0F5 -> &A0F6, so LDY wa_rows_guess,X at &A080 now crosses for X=&0A, +1. The masked renderer's sprite data from straight_35 (&A530) to the end of the bank moves up 1 byte, which changes which (col_ptr),Y and (d_ptr),Y reads in the draw loop, and which BCC on_same_page / BCS data_same_page branches, cross a page for every sprite or cell that straddles one of about 14 page boundaries: per draw that is cycles either way, and it is not counted. The claimed 1.7 cycles a pass (about 1.4 by my count) is the same size as these uncounted moves, so the net could be zero or negative. Unproven, so refuted.
